title: What to Watch This Week: Your Streaming Guide for June 1-7
excerpt: From Madhuri Dixit's dark comedy debut to the Titan origin story, here's everything dropping on Indian and global OTT this week.
body:
June's first week is stacked. Whether you're a Madhuri loyalist, a Titan nerd, or someone who just wants Ranveer Singh screaming at the screen for four hours, this week has something. Here are the picks.

## Maa Behen — Netflix, June 4

**Genre:** Dark comedy thriller | **Language:** Hindi

Madhuri Dixit plays a mother dealing with a dead body, a dysfunctional family, and zero apologies. Triptii Dimri and Ravi Kishan round out a cast that promises chaos in a small-town setting. If the trailer's any indication, this is Madhuri at her most unhinged — and that's exactly why it's worth watching. Netflix has been quietly building a strong Hindi-original slate, and this looks like the week's headliner.

**Why NRIs should care:** Madhuri rarely does dark comedy. This is a side of her that most diaspora audiences haven't seen since Dedh Ishqiya.

## Made in India: A Titan Story — Amazon MX Player, June 3

**Genre:** Business drama | **Language:** Hindi

Jim Sarbh plays Xerxes Desai, the man who built Titan into the brand your parents trusted more than their own children. Naseeruddin Shah is JRD Tata. The series, adapted from Vinay Kamath's book *Titan — India's Most Successful Consumer Brand*, is basically the Indian Succession without the inheritance drama. Director Robby Grewal assembles a cast that also includes Vaibhav Tatwawadi, Namita Dubey, Lakshvir Saran, and Kaveri Seth.

**Why NRIs should care:** Every Indian household abroad has at least one Titan watch. This is the story of the brand that made Swiss quartz nervous.

## Dhurandhar: The Revenge (Raw & Undekha) — JioHotstar, June 4

**Genre:** Spy thriller | **Language:** Hindi

Ranveer Singh's spy blockbuster finally comes home. The uncensored version, which has been dominating Netflix's global charts overseas (1.8 million views in its first weekend, #1 in 9 countries), now arrives on JioHotstar for Indian audiences. At 3 hours and 52 minutes, this is a commitment — but the franchise has earned the right to demand your entire evening.

**Why NRIs should care:** You've probably already watched it on Netflix abroad. Now your parents in India can finally see what the fuss is about.

## Gullak Season 5 — SonyLIV, June 5

**Genre:** Slice-of-life comedy | **Language:** Hindi

The Mishras return, but with a significant change — Anant Joshi replaces Vaibhav Raj Gupta as Annu Bhaiya. Seven episodes of the same middle-class warmth that made Gullak a comfort show for every Indian family that ever argued about electricity bills. If you've been homesick for the sound of a desi household, this is your therapy.

**Why NRIs should care:** Gullak is the most accurate depiction of Indian family life on OTT. Period. The kind of show you watch and then call your mom.

## Brown — ZEE5, June 5

**Genre:** Crime thriller | **Language:** Hindi

Karisma Kapoor is a disgraced cop in Kolkata, battling addiction while hunting a serial killer. Helen makes her return to acting after 14 years. Director Abhinay Deo (Delhi Belly) brings his signature grit. ZEE5 has been quietly producing some strong crime content, and this looks like their best bet for June.

**Why NRIs should care:** Karisma Kapoor choosing a streaming crime drama over a glossy theatrical release says something about where Indian cinema is heading.

## The Pyramid Scheme — Prime Video, June 5

**Genre:** Drama | **Language:** Hindi

Paramvir Cheema plays Goldy, a young man chasing fast money through a pyramid marketing scheme. Ranvir Shorey co-stars. Prime Video's latest Hindi original explores the dark side of India's hustle culture — a story that hits differently when you know someone who fell for one of these schemes.

**Why NRIs should care:** MLM scams don't stop at borders. If you've ever been pitched a "business opportunity" at a desi gathering in New Jersey, this show is for you.

## Patriot — ZEE5, June 5

**Genre:** Action thriller | **Language:** Malayalam

Mammootty, Mohanlal, and Fahadh Faasil in the same film. A former JAG officer exposes a defence spyware conspiracy. Director Mahesh Narayanan. After a solid theatrical run (and ₹200+ crore worldwide for Drishyam 3 proving Malayalam cinema's global pull), Patriot arrives on streaming. It underperformed at the box office relative to its star power, but the cast alone makes it appointment viewing.

**Why NRIs should care:** Three Malayalam legends sharing screen time. This may not happen again for a while.

## Also on the Radar

- **Spider-Noir** (Prime Video) — Nicolas Cage's Marvel spinoff continues its run as the most popular show on the platform. If you haven't started it, now's the time.
- **Grey's Anatomy Season 22** (Netflix, June 6) — Yes, it's still going. Yes, people still watch it.
- **Avatar: The Last Airbender Season 2** (Netflix, June 25) — Not this week, but mark your calendar. The live-action adaptation's strongest arc is coming.

*All release dates are based on current announcements and may shift. Check your preferred platform for availability in your region.*
